key_findings: In OSCC patients, CGRP-immunoreactive nerve density correlated positively with pain and negatively with CD8+ T cell density.

Chronic TRPV1 stimulation with capsaicin worsened tumor growth and immunosuppression, whereas RTX denervation or olcegepant CGRP receptor antagonism slowed tumor growth and improved anti-tumor immunity in mouse OSCC.
